1: Jude urges believers to fight for the faith handed on once for all to the saints. Certain people have crept in who turn grace into an excuse for immorality. He recalls God's past judgements and tells his readers to build themselves up, pray, and show mercy to those who doubt.
The faith is a gift entrusted to the Church, to be kept whole. Jude ends with a hymn to the God who can keep us from falling.
